questions.q: How many days does the 75 Hard challenge last?
questions.why: The summary says to follow five tasks for 75 days straight.

questions.q: What happens if you miss a task in 75 Hard?
a: You start over from day one
questions.why: Lesson 2 says you must restart if you miss even one.

questions.q: Which is one of the five daily tasks?
questions.why: Water, diet, two workouts, a progress photo and reading are the five tasks.

questions.q: How many pages of non-fiction must you read each day?
questions.why: The reading task is 10 pages of a non-fiction book.

questions.q: What does the first week or so of the challenge feel like, according to lesson 3?
a: Exciting, and you learn a lot about yourself
questions.why: Lesson 3 says days one to ten are exciting and full of learning.
